best.fidelity: paper architecture with explicit missing-detail choices; not author code
assumptions: Spatial stage uses gate counts, as Section V-A states.
Initialization-size policy and KL max_iter are not pinned in the paper.
Temporal KL uses locked pair swaps and optional zero-size single moves, with best actual-cost prefixes.
Physical capacity guard is additional to underspecified endpoint-size handling.
Grouped joint QPD execution is not implemented by this placement baseline.
Grouped spatial costs use ln(gamma)/ln(3) in gate-count units; temporal costs use ln(gamma). This convention is not pinned in the paper.
